title: 第888章 法宝之利
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

说着话，孙图身躯微微一震，一身法力崩碎了韩榆血化身、雷电之力星罗丝的缠绕。

显露出一个紫袍绣着白云的中年道士模样。

韩榆一看此人模样，顿时对照上云轩记忆中的紫云老祖。

原来是四洲小天地的化神修士来了！

这紫云老祖问的问题，韩榆自然是不会解释——难道还要帮他解答疑惑，增加经验教训，下次做的更完美不成？

忘忧散人也没有回答，只是将神识笼罩过去。

这道士宽袍大袖，神识法力萦绕，彼此没有交手时候，看不出更多究竟。

神识提醒韩榆：“直接对这道士动手吗？”

韩榆缓缓点头：“对方既然来了，那就把他留下吧！”

忘忧散人手中玉箫一扬，箫声如水波一般荡漾开来。

那紫云老祖见对面两人不肯回答，便喊打喊杀，便冷哼一声。

将手一扬，两件法宝浮现在身前。

一柄雪白顺滑的拂尘，一个翠绿如玉的宽口瓶子。

紫云老祖手握住拂尘，向着箫声一甩。

箫声便如同流水遇上坚石，从中间分开。

虽然忘忧散人立刻又操纵箫声弥合，再次向紫云老祖袭去，但毫无疑问，便又多用一些法力。

“四洲小天地的化神修士，似乎法宝比五域这边更强？”

忘忧散人心中闪过这个念头，并以神识告知韩榆。

韩榆有些意外，又看一眼自己的黑水吉祥宝瓮，顿时感觉这也在情理之中——流州老祖给墨溟的这一件法宝，在五域小天地内的确几乎没见过同类，实用极强。

四洲小天地的化神修士自身实力如何且不说，拥有的法宝可是明显更好；而五域小天地也不知是什么缘故，在化神法宝这方面稍显匮乏。

交战之中，忘忧散人也只是念头升起便给韩榆提个醒，并未耽搁交手，箫声依旧层层荡开，奔向紫云老祖。

紫云老祖见她依旧只有这一招，顿时嗤笑一声：“若你技止于此，那么今日便要死了！”

手中拂尘抬起，先是右边向下，又是左边向下，顿时两次攻击交叉，击开身前箫声。

同时，拂尘上每一根雪白长丝，都化作一根细长的针，对着忘忧散人便爆发出密密麻麻的细针，直奔忘忧散人、韩榆而来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As he spoke, Sun Tu's body shook slightly, and his magic power shattered the entanglement of Han Yu's blood incarnation and the power of thunder star Rose.

A middle-aged Taoist priest wearing a purple robe embroidered with white clouds appeared.

When Han Yu saw this person's appearance, he immediately compared it with the ancestor Ziyun in Yunxuan's memory.

It turns out that the god-transformation monk from Sizhou Xiaotiandi is here!

Han Yu would naturally not be able to explain the question asked by Patriarch Ziyun - should he help him answer his doubts, gain experience and lessons, and do it more perfectly next time?

Wangyou Sanren didn't answer, but just shrouded his consciousness.

This Taoist priest has wide robes and long sleeves, and his spiritual consciousness and magic power are lingering around him. When there is no fight between them, it is impossible to see more of the truth.

Divine consciousness reminded Han Yu: "Do you want to attack this Taoist priest directly?"

Han Yu nodded slowly: "Since the other party is here, let him stay!"

Wangyousan raised the jade flute in his hand, and the sound of the flute rippled like water waves.

Seeing that the two people on the other side refused to answer, the Ziyun Patriarch yelled and killed, and then he snorted coldly.

He raised his hand and two magic weapons appeared in front of him.

A snow-white smooth whisk, and a wide-mouth bottle as green as jade.

Ancestor Ziyun held the fly whisk in his hand and flicked it toward the sound of the flute.

The sound of the flute is like running water meeting a solid stone, parting in the middle.

Although the Wangyou San people immediately controlled the sound of the flute and attacked the ancestor Ziyun again, there was no doubt that they used more magic power.

"It seems that the magic weapons of the god-transformation monks in the Four Continents Small World are stronger than those in the Five Domains?"

This thought flashed through Wangyou Sanren's mind, and he informed Han Yu with his spiritual consciousness.

Han Yu was a little surprised. He took another look at his Black Water Auspicious Treasure Urn, and suddenly felt that this was also reasonable - the magic weapon that Liuzhou Patriarch gave to Mo Ming had indeed been rarely seen of its kind in the Five Realms Small World, and it was extremely practical.

Not to mention the strength of the god-transformation monks in the Four Continents Small World, the magic weapons they possess are obviously better; and for some unknown reason, the five-region small world is slightly lacking in the magic weapons of god transformation.

During the battle, Wangyou Sanren only reminded Han Yu when an idea came up. Without delaying the fight, the sound of the flute still swayed and rushed towards the ancestor Ziyun.

Seeing that she still only had this one move, Patriarch Ziyun immediately sneered: "If your skills stop here, you will die today!"

He raised the whisk in his hand, first downwards from the right side, then downwards from the left side, and immediately the two attacks crossed each other, knocking away the sound of the flute in front of him.

At the same time, every snow-white filament on the fly whisk turned into a slender needle, and densely packed needles burst out towards Wangyou Sanren, heading straight for Wangyou Sanren and Han Yu.
